Body.Content:
Calling reps and supervisor leads can access intelligent call recap for call queue calls directly from the Queues app on Mobile. After a call, users can quickly catch up on the conversation with AI-generated notes, key discussion points, and recommended follow-up tasks, helping reduce the time spent reviewing calls and making it easier to move customer conversations forward while on the go.

GA date: December CY2026
